out_of_engine_mechanics.name: CurJackpotStoreWin progressive
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' is present on every ST140/ST36 round but =0 on 100% of 2,137,588 in-sample records (W1 §5). Its name suggests a stateful progressive jackpot that only accrues/fires across real wallet sessions — a horizon the stateless ResetPlayerStateAfterEachSpin testspin cannot reach. Whether it is a live progressive is a DOMAIN fact, not derivable from rawdata.

out_of_engine_mechanics.name: Wheel meta-progression
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: The 12-cell -> fixed-prize map (cells 8&10 = 100x) is stable in-sample (W1 CROSS-5), but any meta-progression (cells unlock / prizes grow across real play) is invisible to stateless testspin. DOMAIN fact.

out_of_engine_mechanics.name: Skin-11 boost-reel trigger condition
